C1.worst_defect: At 390 px the hero lead paragraph ('VendurePOS is an open-source till for Vendure, the open-source headless commerce framework...') runs to seven centred lines in large grey type, so the CTA pair sits below a slab of ragged centred text that is hard to read.

C2.worst_defect: The home comparison table says the demo 'sends ... anonymous usage events to ph.wcpos.com' without saying what wcpos.com is or how it relates to VendurePOS; a different brand's domain in the privacy row reads as unexplained.
C2.where: home/desktop/02 (table row 'Sales reach Vendure, once each, even offline'); home/phone/04

C3.worst_defect: Step 8 'Sign in and make a sale' is nine lettered prose steps (a-i) with no picture of the sign-in form or the opening-float screen, so the first look a developer gets at the screen they must fill in comes later, on At the till.

C4.worst_defect: Limitations is one flat list of 18 equal-weight bullets with no subheadings, so the right-hand 'On this page' rail is empty and no single limit (refunds, offline reload, Postgres only) can be scanned to or linked.

C5.worst_defect: The At the till payment screenshot has a ~420 px empty white void in the cart column between the three line items and the Subtotal block, so the image is mostly dead space beside a dense keypad; the home hero screenshot also ends mid-tile, slicing a fourth product row at its bottom edge.

C6.worst_defect: On a phone the hero image is a cart-only till view about 1.4 screens tall, with its QTY header cut to 'Q...' and a second button under 'Order discount' clipped by the totals border, so the first visual below the CTAs is a cropped, truncated UI rather than the product.

C7.worst_defect: Quick start's mobile LCP is 2.6 s (Lighthouse largest-contentful-paint 0.88) with render-blocking requests flagged; everything else (titles, descriptions, OG card, JSON-LD, llms.txt, sitemap, robots, search API, real 404) is in place.

overall_worst.defect: The home page's phone hero image is a tall, cropped cart-only till screenshot (QTY header truncated to 'Q...', a button clipped by the totals border) that fills about 1.4 screens straight after the CTAs, so a phone visitor's first impression of the product is a cramped fragment of UI.
overall_worst.fix: On phones, show a shorter crop or a capture made at a phone width that fits the column (e.g. products grid with the cart tab label), capped at about one screen tall with object-fit cover, so no headers are truncated and no buttons are clipped.
